exposure: trial of labor after a previous cesarean
outcome: obstetric factors associated with uterine rupture
cohort: Mothers who experienced uterine rupture, including 27 cases (delivered infants with CP) and 312 cohorts (delivered infants without CP) from the Japan Obstetric Compensation System for CP database and the perinatal database of the Japan Society of Obstetrics and Gynecology
finding: Two-thirds of the relevant obstetric factors for CP associated with uterine rupture were iatrogenic, highlighting the need to avoid reckless delivery management.
mod_finding: Out of the 11 cases of uterine rupture in mothers who delivered infants with cerebral palsy and had scarred uteruses, 7 involved a trial of labor after a previous cesarean.
